verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated sandbox environment that uses simulated data and never connects to real institutions. It also has a sandbox guide with documented test credentials, including an OTP MFA flow whose correct code is `0000`, so developers can exercise linking and challenge flows before going live. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of named test institutions, documented triggers for error states (failed logins, disconnected enrollments), and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end sandbox testing.
